item.title: ACTION 8 UPDATE: Opelika missing teen found safe
item.description: Police say 16-year-old Marcus Thomas, Jr. was last seen around 7:00 p.m. Monday near Wyndham Village Court.

item.title: Widespread rain is expected Tuesday night
item.description: Temperatures should climb into the 60s today before any showers arrive

item.title: Clintons agree to testify in House Epstein investigation ahead of contempt of Congress vote
item.description: The Clintons had resisted the subpoenas for months after the House Oversight Committee issued subpoenas for their testimony last August as it opened an investigation into convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and his associates.

item.title: WATCH: Mayor Steven Reed outlines city progress so far in 2026
item.description: Montgomery Mayor Steven Reed says the city is experiencing positive momentum in public safety, emergency response, infrastructure investment, housing affordability and downtown development.

item.title: Warmer Tuesday, rain Tuesday night through Wednesday morning
item.description: Tuesday morning was fairly sunny, but some clouds mixed in by the afternoon. Rain returns to west Alabama sometime during the afternoon, becoming more widespread through Tuesday night and Wednesday morning.

item.title: YMCA Opens Registration for Stride for Kids Race and Spring Soccer
item.description: The YMCA's 13th annual Stride for Kids Race is set for April 11, 2026, and will include a 5K and a one-mile fun run.

item.title: Ex-husband of former First Lady Jill Biden charged with killing wife
item.description: The ex-husband of former first lady Jill Biden has been charged with killing his wife at their Delaware home.

item.title: Cloudy And Wet Overnight
item.description: Light to moderate rain is likely overnight into early Wednesday

item.title: Three men face arson charges in Marion fire
item.description: Authorities in Perry County have arrested three Marion men on arson charges.

item.title: Ft. Deposit finally swears in new mayor, most of town council
item.description: Ft. Deposit has now sworn in a new mayor and most of its town council after having to hold elections for a second time.
